title: Panther on the LRT
style: Phonk comedy with a sneaky mid-tempo bounce, halftime drums, dusty cowbell, trunk-rattling sub, and beatboxed percussion tucked under the groove. Verse rides dry and close with playful Canadian local references; pre-chorus strips to handclaps, harmonic pads, and whispered Spanish licks; chorus hits with gang sing-along backing singers, stuttered ad-libs, and a prowling bass line. Crisp punchy mix with a dark grin and bright vocal stacks., comedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Boots on the slush, move quiet, eh
I slide past the rink with a café tray
Maple syrup grin, but the eyes stay mean
Black cat energy in a red machine

[Tat-tat kss] I’m under the bridge by the river bend
Hockey bag smell in the backseat ден?
No, just a laugh and a sideways glance
I’m the little moonwalk in a moose-hair dance

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold up, wait
No mames, qué fue?
I’m coming soft
Then I take the lane
Ooh, ooh
Prowl on through
Ooh, ooh
Who invited you?

[Chorus]
Panther on the LRT
Panther on the LRT
Sneak past town, so easy
Panther on the LRT
(ay, ay)
Panther on the LRT
(uh-huh)
Panther on the LRT
I’m a grin with teeth

[Verse 2]
Tim's cup clack when I turn that corner
Backyard BBQ, but I’m still a stalker
Cardigan wave with a sly “bonjour”
Then I dip like smoke through a screen door

Beatbox kicks from the whole front row
Boom-ka tss, let the whole thing roll
Mi gente say “dale” when I cross that line
And the aunties clap in perfect time

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold up, wait
No mames, qué fue?
I’m coming soft
Then I take the lane
Ooh, ooh
Prowl on through
Ooh, ooh
Who invited you?

[Chorus]
Panther on the LRT
Panther on the LRT
Sneak past town, so easy
Panther on the LRT
(ay, ay)
Panther on the LRT
(uh-huh)
Panther on the LRT
I’m a grin with teeth

[Bridge]
Yo, pass me the mic and the whole room leans
Two-step sway with the northern scenes
Harmonic choir goes “ah-ah-ah”
While I ghost through the block like a stray black car

Eh, qué rico
Qué tal, qué tal
I show up smooth
Then I vanish fast

[Final Chorus]
Panther on the LRT
Panther on the LRT
Sneak past town, so easy
Panther on the LRT
(ay, ay)
Panther on the LRT
(uh-huh)
Panther on the LRT
I’m a grin with teeth
